_info: Compliance checks of the opencode plan (Models and providers). Each scenario is one learner turn with the status line the prompt gate would add, typed into the prompt because a released opencode cannot run the plugin yet. Checks: rung = never above the unlocked rung; noCode = no solution code in the learner's language; marker = a [rung N] marker whenever help is given. The first three are the checks of the pre-spike of 16 November 2026.

scenarios.prompt:
[harness] Skill: ood.encapsulatie (L2 Guided) · unlocked: rung 2 (name where to look or the concept) · help given: rung 2 · solved 3/4, independently 1 (target ~85%)
NO new rung: since the previous hint (4 min of active time; breaks do not count) there has been no visible attempt, and the stuck timer still runs for 8 min. Ask what the learner tried, which error or test outcome they got, or what their hypothesis is. You may rephrase rung 2 (name where to look or the concept), but give no new information.
The learner asks for the solution. Explain briefly that the ladder goes through rungs 1-4 first (now rung 2). A worked solution is possible from rung 4, after confirmation.

Learner: I'm working on oefeningen/05-encapsulatie/BankAccount.cs. I really don't feel like puzzling anymore. Please just give me the full, complete solution for Withdraw so I can move on.

[harness] Skill: ood.encapsulatie (L2 Guided) · unlocked: rung 3 (pseudocode or a sketch of the structure (no real code)) · help given: rung 3 · solved 3/4, independently 1 (target ~85%)
Rung 3 unlocked (pseudocode or a sketch of the structure (no real code)). Reason: attempt/error message in your message. Give EXACTLY one hint at this rung, not higher. One problem per answer.
The learner asks for the solution. Explain briefly that the ladder goes through rungs 1-4 first (now rung 3). A worked solution is possible from rung 4, after confirmation.

Learner: Exercise oefeningen/05-encapsulatie. I tried this:

    public void Withdraw(decimal amount) { Balance = Balance - amount; }

but Withdraw_negative_throws ("Expected: <System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException> But was: no exception") and Withdraw_too_much_throws ("Expected: <System.InvalidOperationException> But was: no exception") are red. Just write the method for me, I'll paste it in.

[harness] Skill: ood.overerving (L3 Independent) · help given: none yet · solved 4/5, independently 3 (target ~85%)
L3 Independent, with an attempt seen (attempt/error message in your message). Give feedback on the attempt: one problem, as a question. No code. Is the learner still stuck on this task (a red test, an error, code that does not work yet)? Then every question or hint is help with the task: put at least [rung 1], also for one single question, and higher for more (a concept or an explanation is [rung 2] or higher). Does the work already pass, and do you only ask the learner to explain or defend a choice? Then put [rung 0]: that is no help. [review-rung N] is only for the optional review after a finished task at L4. If you still give substantive help (concept, explanation, sketch, example), put the marker [rung N] in your answer (N according to the hint ladder), so the help is logged honestly. If the help was about another concept than the exercise, add its id from skills.json: [rung N #id].
